speaker: dr_stephanie_barnett
text: Sheldon, what are you doing here?

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Hang on. 130 over 80. A little high. We can attribute that to the stress of sneaking past the security desk.

speaker: dr_stephanie_barnett
text: Where did you get the stethoscope and the blood pressure cuff?

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: My aunt Marion gave them to me for my 12th birthday. She thought if I failed at theoretical physics that I should have a trade to fall back on. And by the way, the blood pressure cuff is called a sphygmomanometer.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Didn't they teach you that in medical school?

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: I understand. All I need is for you to authorize these tests.

speaker: dr_stephanie_barnett
text: A cardiac stress test, a full body MRI, an electromyogram, a CBC, baseline glucose, upper GI?

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Oh, and an exploratory laparoscopy. Last time I had hiccups, it felt like my diaphragm was just going through the motions.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Can I at least have the upper GI? I already drank the barium!

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Oh, good. Do you have any fabric softener?
